context: Main eval weighted implementation: selected because without-context missed the teeing criterion; covers Collectors.teeing, minBy/maxBy, takeWhile, and dropWhile.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Creates PriceRangeAndPackets.java with requested methods and records.

checklist.name: Uses teeing for price range
checklist.description: Uses Collectors.teeing with minBy and maxBy by Product::price, or an equivalent single-pass pair reduction.

checklist.name: Handles empty price range
checklist.description: Returns a Pair whose left and right are null for an empty product list.

checklist.name: Uses takeWhile for before-spike prefix
checklist.description: Uses takeWhile(packet -> packet.loss() <= threshold) or an equivalent prefix-preserving loop, not filter.

checklist.name: Uses dropWhile for after-prefix remainder
checklist.description: Uses dropWhile(packet -> packet.loss() <= threshold) or an equivalent prefix-skipping loop, not a filter that removes later healthy packets.

checklist.name: Keeps implementation focused
checklist.description: Keeps the implementation focused on the requested stream helpers without unrelated abstractions, caching, concurrency, or API redesign.

metadata.main_eval_selection: selected from all-26 Sonnet 4.6 run because at least one without-context criterion scored below 50%
